entries.german:
Abt Wilhelm und der Konvent von St. Gallen übertragen dem Kloster Magdenau das Eigentumsrecht an gekauften Besitzungen.

Wilhelmus dei gratia abbas monasterii sancti Galli 1 totusque conventus monasterii eiusdem omnibus presens scriptum intuentibus salutem || in domino et notitiam subscriptorum. Ne res gesta oblivionis corrosa ferugine nonnumquam discensionis valeat materiam exhibere, || expedit, ut litterarum memorie commendetur. Noverint itaque universi et singuli Christi fideles, quos nosce fuerit oportunum, quod || cum dilectus ministerialis nostri monasterii dominus Egl. de Rosinberg 2 quasdam possessiones comparaverit pro dilectis in Christo . . abbatisse b) et conventu monasterii in Magginowe 3, quarum proprietatem nobis nostroque contribuit monasterio et a nobis recepit in feodum, ad peticionem eiusdem dicteque abbatisse et conventus, communicato sapientum consilio ac intuentes nostri monasterii utilitatem, obligationem huiusmodi subintravimus, quod salvis nobis censibus et aliis iuribus quibuscumque nostro monasterio debitis a monasterio in Maginowe memorato, sineremus et permitteremus, ut sepefata . . abbatissa et conventus de possessionibus, quorum b) nobis pertineret proprietas, septem marcharum redditus compararent, ita ut eorundem reddituum proprietas ex donatione et licentia nostri dicto monasterio in Magginowe pertineret, sicut in instrumento super hoc confecto plenius continetur. Et quia prelibati abbatissa et conventus per manus nostras rite et legitime has possessiones compararunt, videlicet in villa ze Swarcinbach 4 curiam quondam dicti de Luterberg 5 solventem XIII frusta, item possessiones dictas der Omin 6 gůt solventes I quartale et VI frusta, item ibidem quandam advocatiam quarundam proprietatum solventem I denarium et III solidos, item in villa Gebrehzwiler 7 curiam dictam bi dem Bach solventem XI frusta, item ibidem possessiones quondam Wernh. de Breginsdorf 8 solventes III frusta et VI denarios, item in villa Bacinhaede 9 decimam, que fuerat H. de Yberg 10, solventem V frusta, et decimam ze dem A echbuel 11 solventem II frusta, item ze O etenwile 12 decimam unum frustum solventem, que similiter due decime fuerant H. de Yberg, item in curia ze Sigiswiler 13 decimam quondam dicti de Vurberg 14 solventem I frustum, item ze A enwile 15 prope Vurberg possessiones quondam dicti de Vurberg redditus II frustorum, item in villa ze Tonrton 16 curiam et decimam, que similiter fuerant dicti de Vurberg, solventes XXV frusta, item an der Staeg 17 sub Ramsowe 18 decimam solventem II quartalia, per quas possessiones pensantes suffitienter de redditibus VII marcharum ipsam abbatissam et conventum licentiam et reconpensationem habuisse, cupientes promissum nostrum et obligationem plenius exsolvere, proprietates dictarum possessionum cum suis iuribus et annexis in refusionem et reconpensationem possessionum conparatarum per dictum de Rosinberg pretacto monasterio in Magginowe damus tradimus et donamus cum omni sollempnitate iuris verborum et gestuum debita et consweta, ita tamen, ut in nostris censibus et iuribus nichil nobis nostroque monasterio depereat ex donatione huiusmodi quovismodo alias preter contributionem memoratam. Volumus etiam per hoc exonerari ab oligatione b) premissa et esse ab eadem penitus absoluti. Promittimus insuper bona fide non contra venire verbo vel facto ac renuntiantes exceptionibus doli mali, beneficio restitutionis in integrum, litteris a sede apostolica vel aliunde inpetratis vel inpetrandis, deceptionis ultra dimid(ium) et generaliter singulis ac singulariter universis iuribus, per que contra premissa venire possit aliquis vel ea aliqualiter irritare. In horum autem evidentiam sigilla nostra duximus presentibus apponenda. Dat. apud sanctum Gallum, anno domini millesimo C°C°.LXXXXIX°. III. non. febr. ind. XII a. Presentibus nobili viro Craftoni b) de Togginburg comite canonico ecclesie Constantiensis 19, Hug. comite de Jagberg 20, domino H. de Griessinberg 21, domino V olr. dicto Giel 22, domino Bur. advocato de Wartinse 23, V olr. dicto Giel 22, Jo. de Lindinberg 24, Dieth. de Mos 25, V olr. Advocatus b), Jo. de Husen 26, domino Eber. de Bichilnse 27, C. de Gaenwile 28, . . filius b) Bur. de Magilsberg 29 et aliis quam pluribus fidedignis.

Siegel: 2 Siegel, 1. fehlt; 2. zerbröckelt, eingenäht.
entries.english:
Abbot Wilhelm and the convent of St Gall transfer to Magdenau Abbey ownership of estates that had been purchased.

Wilhelm, by the grace of God abbot of the monastery of St Gall, and the entire convent of that monastery greet all who see this document and make known the following. To prevent events from being obscured by oblivion and becoming a cause of dispute, they should be committed to written memory. Let all the faithful know that our monastery’s ministerial, Lord Egelolf von Rosenberg, purchased certain estates for the beloved abbess and convent of Magdenau Abbey. He transferred ownership of these estates to us and our monastery and received them back from us as a fief. At his request and that of the abbess and convent, after taking counsel with wise men and considering the benefit to our monastery, we undertook to allow the abbess and convent to acquire, from estates whose ownership belonged to us, revenues worth seven marks, while reserving to ourselves all rents and other rights due to our monastery from Magdenau, as more fully set out in the instrument made for this purpose.

Since the abbess and convent have lawfully acquired these estates through our agency, namely: in Schwarzenbach, the court formerly belonging to the person called von Luterberg, yielding 13 measures; the estates called the Omen estate, yielding one quarter and six measures; and an advocacy over certain estates there, yielding one penny and three shillings; in Gebrazwil, the court called by the Bach, yielding 11 measures, and the estates formerly belonging to Wernher von Breginsdorf, yielding three measures and six pennies; in Bächinheide, the tithe formerly belonging to H. von Yberg, yielding five measures, and the tithe at the Aechbüel, yielding two measures; at Oetenwil, a tithe yielding one measure, both tithes formerly belonging to H. von Yberg; at Sigiswil, a tithe formerly belonging to the person called von Vurberg, yielding one measure; at Aenwil near Vurberg, estates formerly belonging to the person called von Vurberg, yielding two measures; at Tonrton, a court and tithe also formerly belonging to von Vurberg, yielding 25 measures; and at the Staeg below Ramsau, a tithe yielding two quarters. These estates provide sufficient revenue for the seven marks. Since the abbess and convent have thus received the authorization and compensation, and we wish fully to discharge our promise and obligation, we give, transfer, and donate to Magdenau Abbey the ownership of these estates, with their rights and appurtenances, as compensation for the estates purchased by the aforesaid von Rosenberg. This donation is made with all due legal formalities, provided that no rents or other rights due to us and our monastery are lost by it, apart from the contribution already described. We also wish thereby to be discharged from the aforesaid obligation.

We promise in good faith not to act contrary to this agreement in word or deed, and renounce defenses based on fraud, restitution in integrum, letters obtained or to be obtained from the Apostolic See or elsewhere, inadequacy of price, and every right by which anyone might challenge or invalidate these terms. In testimony, we have attached our seals.

Given at St Gall in the year 1299, on 3 February, indiction 12. Present were the noble Crafto, Count of Toggenburg and canon of Constance; Hugo, Count of Jagberg; Lord H. von Griessenberg; Lord Ulrich called Giel; Lord Burkhard, advocate of Wartensee; Ulrich called Giel; Johannes von Lindenberg; Dietrich von Mos; Ulrich Advocatus; Johannes von Husen; Lord Eberhard von Bichilnse; C. von Gaenwil; a son of Burkhard von Magilsberg; and many other trustworthy people.

Seals: Two seals, the first missing, the second crumbled and sewn in.
